book.title: Nzaelwapx-krbz Jiszs Mz Jon Da Kcng Tqyc-kapq-pnzng

content: Bongavz Kxmrna X Drtc' Kxmrna
Zbz obq-rmiwble-moux, x mcx kc bongavz kxmrna x drtc' kxmrna, kx trpnzngr prla ngrde. Bongavz kc kai ncdr drtc' nzmrbrpeng.
X mcx mzteadau kxtr, Jerusalem kxmrna, prpxpem Heven mrkc tqmncngr Gct, x sc tqvzom. Mzteadau lc tqtr nzoliqtipe x mzte lqngi, apule olvz kx nayrlz kc tzaoliq mz nzyrlz-krdr ncdr ncblo ngrde.
X xlrx kc natq kxetu aepztr mz tron, rpile kx,

content.text: X Gct esz'-krde sa nanginide Gct rdr.

content: Zbz sc tqrpipem Gct kc tqwxbuom mz tron bange kx, “Yro natq lcng, murde da angidr lcng x sa natutrng. Mzli ka atubqtipe-moux da amrlx!

Eu, kapupxpe! Murde ninge nou da amrlx x kx ayrkrpx da amrlx, x ninge kz kx ryzutr da amrlx x kx nzamrbrtx mou. Sa naka-nrbalqbo mz leplz kcng drtwrdr tzbrlxkzng, lue kx yrlelzm mz vaulz ngr nzlungr kxmrna, murde nalu-moung.
Sa nakabo da lcng mz leplz kcng tzaovxiong mz nzvec-krdr badr zmatqng kxtrka. X sa nanginibo Gct rdr, x sa nanginidr doa nengeng.

A' krkcng tzmwxlrtilr nzbz-krdr mz nzvz-nqblq-krdr Jiszs, nzesablqtilr nide, x nzprszpxlr nide mz nzangio-krdr gct kx trngiu Gct angidr, nzrnibqng, nzrmwiming doa kx trngiu krnalzdr, nzrngineting dabo, nzangiong mqngr drka' kxnzlz, x nzpokiang. Leplz lcng sa nartco-ngrng mz Dxbu Nyr kc tqngc mz rplz salfz. Krlc nzbzngr kxrmnrngr, x leplz lcng nzlakipx-lzbqmqng bange, tqyc tqyc.”
Jerusalem Kxmrna
Enjrl kcng rlimz mzli kc nzkabz badr nzayrplapxngr kx nzrmnr-ngrmqng rlimz. Zbz kzdq nidr vzm bange rpimle kx, “Vzm, murde na-aelwa-ngrbo bam Olvz r Nei Sip kc tqyrlz ate.”
X enjrl kc sc tqvzmilzpele ninge, mz zmatq ngr Mqngrkxtr, mz kzdq newz kxetu x vzdz wq. Sc tqaelwapx-ngrmle bange Jerusalem, mzteadau kxtr kc tqvzpxm mz Gct Heven.
X zluli r Gct aglqpz'ngr Mzteadau lc apule rplz daemon kc tqlqlwx-esz'ngr x nzopx-krde apule dzpq.
X ngrlelvz drkq kx xplr x vzdz wq. X naonrx ngrde nzpnu-esz'-nrade-li (12), naonrx kcng taplxsr enjrl kxnzaclveng x nzataplxsr nzryrtrngr drtq neidu lr leplz ne Israel kcng nzpnu-esz'-nrade-li (12).
Naonrx tq lxblr mz nrlar Mzteadau kxesz'.
X nzwzngr drkq lcdeng mz nou rplz nzpnu-esz'-nrade-li (12), x nzataplxsrngr nzryrtrngr drtq aposol neng Nei Sip.
Enjrl kc tqycmnem bange malele kc neni kx ngi gol kx nzanengr Mzteadau, naonrx ngrdeng, x drkq ngrde.

Mzteadau trpnzngr nrlarde kxboi, a' kx namu-txpwzlr esz'. Enjrl kc anele mzteadau mz neni kc tqmalele, x krlzbzle stadia siu-nzpnu-esz'-nrade-li (12,000), (kc tqngi kilomita siu-li-trtqki-pwx (2,400)). Nzboi-krde, nzetupx-krde x me krlzlzbz drkq ngrde, kxnamu-txpwzlr esz'.

Enjrl kc ane-kzle nzvekr drkq ngr Mzteadau, x krlzbzle kubit trtqki-esz'-nzpnu-pwx-nrade-pwx (144), (kc tqngi mita nzpnu-esz'mz-nrade-esz'mz (66)), vzpxm mz noabx kc tqane-ngrde, kc tqngi noabx sc leplz.
Drkq ngrde nzwz esz'ngr mz rplz kxprki, x Mzteadau esz'-krde nzwz esz'ngr mz gol kxlq, x nzpnapr-krde apule dzpq.

Nou rplz kcng mz drkq ngr Mzteadau nzmrlzng murde nzwzngr mz rplz kxlqlwx. Nou drkq kc kai rplz kxprki, krali rplz kxblutxpx apule nzopxkr bongavz mz nrlc kxngrlx, kratq rplz kxbx, krapwx rplz kxmqbq.

X kranzlvqn rplz kxbotapz', kraesz'mz rplz kxpc, krarlimz rplz kxplctxpx, krartqmz rplz kxblu apule nzblukr bongavz, krarpwxmz rplz kxyzlo, kranzpnu rplz kxplc, kranzpnu-esz'-nrade-esz' rplz kxbla, x kranzpnu-esz'-nrade-li rplz kxprpol.

X naonrx kcng nzpnu-esz'-nrade-li nzwzngr mz prl kxlqlwx amrlx. Naonrx esz' kc tzwzngr mz prl kxetu kx aglqpz' apule nelc, x lrpzki kxetu kc tqvz vau r Mzteadau nzwzngr mz gol, x nzlq-krde apule nzopxkr dzpq.
A' trpnzngr Mangr-nzangiongr kx mcx Mzteadau mrkc tqmnc-ngrbz Gct badr leplz nedeng. Murde Kxetu Gct kc tqrninr ncdr Nei Sip nztekqtrlr Mangr-nzangiongr mz nzangiongr nidr mz nrlc amrlx Mzteadau.
X Mzteadau lc tryzlr-ngru mz zyzlr ngr nepi o temz, murde zluli r Gct ncdr Nei Sip, dela na-angrlxpele nide.

X leplz kxnztubqng mrkcng amrlx mz nrlc, sa navzneng mz zyzlr ngrde, mz nzvz-nqblq-krde me pnz drtwr Gct. X king amrlx mz nrlc kcng tztubqng kz sa naprtrpzng mz Mzteadau, mz nzrglqlz-krdr Gct ncdr Nei Sip.
Mzli kc bqnc, naonrx ngr taon nzbq mz nrlckxbq. A' mz Mzteadau kxmrna, naonrx ngrdeng trtxpengr nzrbqpx-ngrng, murde trpnzngr nrlckxbq mrlcde.
X leplz lcng tztubqng sa naprtrpzng mz Mzteadau. X sa natwzlr dztudrng kxmrlzvxing kxlqlwxng.

A' trtxpnzngr da kx trtakitrdeu mz nzobqkr Gct kx naprtrpzng mz Mzteadau, x trpnzngr leplz kx nzrtrngz-abeaneng da kx myangr drtq, x kxnzpokiang. A' nangi txpwz krkcng drtqdr tzyrope mz Buk ngr Nzlungr sc Nei Sip, nidr lang kx naprtrng elr.

footnotes.text: Mz ngalrde lcng, opxm kx nabz 12,000 x 144 nzycmne-ebzpx-ngrdr nabz 12. Murde nabz 12 vzm mz mzlir rlilrdr. 12 X 1,000 = 12,000. 12 X 12 = 144. Mz Nzryrngrkxtr, nabz 12 nzrpibz nabz ngr nzayrkrpxngr da.
